Mushoku Tensei began serialization on Shōsetsuka ni Narō in November 2012 and its first commercial light novel was published on January 24, 2014 by Media Factory under the MF Books imprint [d45397527s4p0][d45397527s0p0].
Reincarnated Into a Game as the Hero's Friend began serialization on Shōsetsuka ni Narō on March 2, 2021 and its first commercial light novel was published on March 25, 2022 by Overlap under the Overlap Bunko imprint [d78622968s2p0][d78622968s0p0].
Enough with This Slow Life began on Shōsetsuka ni Narō in October 2020 and its first commercial light novel publication was April 2021 by Earth Star Entertainment under the Earth Star Novel imprint [d82475043s0p0].
Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers began on Shōsetsuka ni Narō on May 9, 2018 and its first commercial light novel publication was March 25, 2019 by Overlap under the Overlap Bunko imprint [d79672102s2p0].
The White Cat's Revenge as Plotted from the Dragon King's Lap began on Shōsetsuka ni Narō in January 2015 and its first commercial light novel publication was October 2016 by Frontier Works under the ArianRose imprint [d79019513s0p0].

sub_answers.sub_question: Which recurring plot devices and conceits (for example: protagonist rebirth, being summoned to another world, game-like rule systems, XP farming, talent/system grind) are characteristic of online-origin isekai novels, and can you list representative titles that exemplify each device?
sub_answers.text: Isekai commonly features a protagonist transported to, reborn in, or trapped in a parallel universe. [d3021538s13p0] Isekai often uses virtual-world conceits inspired by video games. [d3021538s13p0] Representative early virtual-world titles include Digimon Adventure and .hack. [d3021538s13p0] Sword Art Online exemplifies the video-game-turned-virtual-world conceit, while Log Horizon and Overlord exemplify settings that are formerly virtual worlds that become real. [d3021538s13p0] My One-Hit Kill Sister is an example of a work that originated as a web novel on a user-generated publishing site. [d70280003s0p0]

sub_answers.sub_question: In web-published isekai stories, how are diegetic mechanics such as visible status windows, numerical attributes, skill trees, quest logs, and explicit level-up events depicted in text, and how do authors use those mechanics to drive conflict, character growth, or plot turning points?

What narrative and voice conventions are prevalent in serialized isekai from web platforms — including common choices of POV (first vs. third person), chapter-level structures (self-contained vs. continuation), frequent authorial asides or afterwords, and use of diary/log formats — and which works illustrate each convention?
sub_answers.text: My One-Hit Kill Sister was serialized online on the user-generated novel publishing website Shōsetsuka ni Narō from December 2019 to June 2023. [d70280003s0p0] No Longer Allowed in Another World has been serialized on Shogakukan's Yawaraka Spirits website since October 2019. [d69700096s0p0]
